title: bzf consumption
description: Measured consumption of a building, `consumption/<id>.json`: its meters and the amounts read or billed per period, each with where it came from (a bill among the received files). It is what a consumption-based Energieausweis takes, what the EPBD's Annex V may show as metered consumption and its databases hold (Art. 22), and the logbook's operation and use. Consumption of a home tells about the people in it, so it is shared only with the owner's consent like every building document. This schema describes documents of schema version 1.x; a document of another major version is only required to say which.

periods.description: Amounts read or billed, oldest first.

vacancy.description: Periods the building or part of it stood empty, as a share of its area, which a consumption-based method corrects for.

share.description: The share of the area that stood empty, as a fraction.

meter.description: A meter, or a supply billed without one (oil by delivery, wood by the stere).

services.description: What its carrier is used for, where known.

system.description: The meter in the building's systems, where it is one.

serves.description: The parts or spaces it measures; all of the building where absent.

period.description: An amount over a period: as read from the meter, as billed, or estimated.

carrier.description: Where it has no meter, its carrier.

unit.description: The unit the amount is in, as read or billed: kWh, MWh, m³, l, kg, t, rm (stacked cubic metres), srm (loose cubic metres).

source.description: Where it came from: the bill among the received files.
